answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 12902 Country: India Title: I AM WORKING IN A CALL CENTRE IN MUMBAI , MY JOB REQUIRES TO CALL THE CLIENTS IN UK , WHO HAVE PURCHASED CREDIT CARD FROM OUR COMPANY ,WE HAVE TO COLLECT THE AMOUNT BY CALLING THEM ,AS THE CLIENTS DONT PAY THE AMOUNT BEFORE DUE DATE , SO THE COMPANY CHARGES THEM WITH INTERST ON THEIR CREDIT CARD ,SO WE HAVE TO CALL THE CUSTOMERS TO REMIND THEM ABOUT THE MONEY WHICH THEY OWE TO THE COMPANY .SO IS THIS JOB OF MINE HALAAL OR HARAM,PLZ REPLY QUICKLY Question: I AM WORKING IN A CALL CENTRE IN MUMBAI , MY JOB REQUIRES TO CALL THE CLIENTS IN UK , WHO HAVE PURCHASED CREDIT CARD FROM OUR COMPANY ,WE HAVE TO COLLECT THE AMOUNT BY CALLING THEM ,AS THE CLIENTS DONT PAY THE AMOUNT BEFORE DUE DATE , SO THE COMPANY CHARGES THEM WITH INTERST ON THEIR CREDIT CARD ,SO WE HAVE TO CALL THE CUSTOMERS TO REMIND THEM ABOUT THE MONEY WHICH THEY OWE TO THE COMPANY .SO IS THIS JOB OF MINE HALAAL OR HARAM,PLZ REPLY QUICKLY Answer ID: 12902 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 750/582=L/1430) Yes, your job is permissible and the income earned through it is lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
